svg.text: PLAN · at the floor plates (0.9 m above base) looking down · port side up · NTS SVG preview
ELEVATION · section at the centreline looking to port · stern left
SECTION at z 10.8 looking forward · through the main engines
7 Pumps: fire and GS, fire and bilge, GS, bilge, sanitary, hydrophore
9 Sea-water strainers (sea chests under the plates)
Builder: Johansson Shipyard (ヨハンソン造船), Innoshima, Seto
Inland Sea: hull No. 127, an island ferry like the dozens
before her. Machinery: Johansson Marine, Johansson Marine
M/V MINATO MARU みなと丸 · hull No. 127
ENGINE ROOM ARRANGEMENT · plan at the floor plates, centreline elevation, section
Every rectangle is a box of FERRY_INTERIOR as built (ferry-interior.js); circles are
its cylinders; the coloured lines are geometry-checked external routes; C1 fuel
interfaces are proposed. Installation, bends, sleeves and supplier approvals remain
open. Numbers key the equipment list.
FOR DESIGN REVIEW - schematic game reference; no construction approval; SVG views NTS
